0:
set -eu
git config --global --add safe.directory /config
if [ -f /config/configuration.yaml ]; then
  echo "/config already initialized, skipping clone"
  exit 0
fi
if [ -n "$(find /config -mindepth 1 -not -name 'lost+found' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: /config is not empty but has no configuration.yaml; refusing to clone" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git config --global http.extraHeader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GIT_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
git clone --branch "$GIT_BRANCH" "$GIT_REPO_URL" /config
echo "Cloned $GIT_REPO_URL ($GIT_BRANCH) into /config"

set -e
git config --global --add safe.directory /config
git config --global http.extraHeader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$GIT_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
exec sh /config/utils/commit-all.sh

rm -rf /home/seanime/.config/Seanime
ln -s /seanime /home/seanime/.config/Seanime
if [ ! -f /seanime/config.toml ]; then
  cat > /seanime/config.toml << 'TOML'
version = '3.9.1'

[cache]
dir = '/cache'
transcodedir = '/cache/transcode'

[database]
name = 'seanime'

[extensions]
dir = '/seanime/extensions'

[logs]
dir = '/seanime/logs'

[anime]
downloaddir = '/media/anime'

[manga]
downloaddir = '/media/manga'
localdir = '/seanime/manga-local'

[offline]
assetdir = '/seanime/offline/assets'
dir = '/seanime/offline'

[server]
host = '0.0.0.0'
offline = false
port = 80
usebinarypath = true
secureMode = 'lax'
accessAllowlist = ['https://*.${SECRET_DOMAIN}']

[torrent]
dir = '/media/downloads/completed/seanime'

[web]
assetdir = '/seanime/assets'
TOML
fi
exec /app/seanime
